rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun compounded with mantra; object of avijñāya
absolutive expressing prior condition of not knowing
traditional remembered text named as object

items.question: What scriptural study remains incomplete without knowledge of this mantra?
premises: This mantra is a specific object of knowledge.
Purāṇa, saṃhitā, and smṛti are named scriptural texts.
Engagement with these texts can occur without knowing this mantra.
items.inference: Study of purāṇa, saṃhitā, and smṛti without knowing this mantra lacks that essential knowledge.
uncertainties: The main verb governing the listed texts is not present in this verse and must be supplied from context.
items.plain_english: Without knowing this mantra, one may engage with purāṇa, saṃhitā, and smṛti.
